tokens.name: magenta
tokens.usage: Primary brand + CTA neon (MUI primary.main). Text on ink/surface at 5.9:1 / 5.6:1; focus border on inputs; selected nav item; hover tint at 07–20% alpha.

tokens.name: magenta-deep
tokens.usage: Hover / pressed magenta (primary.dark); gradient start on hovered CTAs. As text on ink only 4.0:1 — keep it to fills.

tokens.name: magenta-glow
tokens.usage: Gradient stop and glow (primary.light); the hanko mark's kanji fill. Text on ink 7.8:1.

tokens.name: cyan
tokens.usage: Secondary + 'AI / scanning' accent (MUI secondary, info): AI chips, Inspect button, selection highlight at 33%, logo scan ticks. 14.4:1 on ink.

tokens.name: cyan-deep
tokens.usage: Deeper cyan stop for cyan fills and hovers.

tokens.name: purple
tokens.usage: Gradient bridge — the contained Button runs magenta → purple. Text on ink 4.4:1 (just under AA): use for fills and large text.

tokens.name: amber
tokens.usage: Highlight / warning (MUI warning.main) — CRT gold; stale-briefing notices. 11.6:1 on ink.

tokens.name: amber-light
tokens.usage: Lighter warning stop (warning.light).

tokens.name: green
tokens.usage: Success / terminal green (MUI success.main): 'signed in' HUD text, success chips. 15:1 on ink.

tokens.name: red
tokens.usage: Error (MUI error.main): destructive buttons, failed states. 5.9:1 on ink.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Page background (background.default) — deep purple-black under the magenta/cyan ambient blooms and scanlines.

tokens.name: ink-deep
tokens.usage: Deeper stops: scrollbar track, darkest gradient ends.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, panels, Paper, tooltips (background.paper).

tokens.name: surface-2
tokens.usage: Sunken stops: input fills, drawers, the bottom of card gradients.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Borders and dividers — dim electric purple (MUI divider). Only 1.3:1 on ink: decorative hairline, not a control's only boundary.

tokens.name: line-glow
tokens.usage: Hover border on inputs and outlined controls (1.9:1 on ink — pair with a magenta focus state).

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Primary text — slight lavender warmth (text.primary). 18:1 on ink, 17:1 on surface.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text (text.secondary): descriptions, metadata, inactive tabs. 6.3:1 on ink, 6.1:1 on surface.

tokens.name: dim
tokens.usage: Tertiary text and disabled icons. 3.2:1 on ink — only for 24px+ text or non-essential hints (fails AA for body copy).

tokens.name: chrome
tokens.usage: Neutral chrome for HUD elements.

tokens.name: violet
tokens.usage: Legacy alias kept from the RoleMiner-era rename sweep — resolves to magenta. Prefer `magenta` in new code.

tokens.name: violet-2
tokens.usage: Legacy alias → purple; still used for the third accent (briefing section icons, Semantic code card). Prefer `purple`.

tokens.name: violet-deep
tokens.usage: Legacy alias → magenta-deep. Prefer `magenta-deep`.
